definition.def: An accumulation of something is a large number of things which have been collected together or acquired over a period of time.
examples: ...an accumulation of experience and knowledge. [+ of]

definition.def: Accumulation is the collecting together of things over a period of time.
examples: ...the accumulation of capital and the distribution of income. [+ of]
The rate of accumulation decreases with time.

examples.sentence: Though the young player had been doing well in the tournament, she began having difficulty regulating her breathing and heart rate during a match, which she later attributed to "the accumulation of the excitement and the buzz".
Integrating these methods into our lives will be important if the cycle of stress accumulation that is so endemic in modern Western society is to be stopped.

Because it softens and dissolves keratin, a kind of 'glue' in the skin's structure, salicylic acid is able to treat many conditions in which the skin has suffered from an excessive accumulation or clogging of skin cells.
Long-term use, however, is discouraged because an accumulation of bismuth subsalicylate in the body is toxic.
